title: AI on macOS 26
steps: On a Mac running macOS 26, open Help › Show Welcome Guide and go to the AI step
Click Set Up… next to Use Claude Code or Codex
Look at Models in Settings › AI
expected: The AI step says Apple's on-device model isn't available on this Mac because Mail needs macOS 27 for it, shows Download a small model as Coming in a later version and offers Use Claude Code or Codex. Set Up… opens Settings › AI, where the Apple row says it needs macOS 27 and Claude Code and Codex can be allowed.
